response.text:
Bharat mein dark spots aur dull skin ke liye **Vitamin C serum** ek bahut hi accha choice hai. Yeh skin ko brighten karne, pigmentation aur dark spots ko fade karne, aur ek natural glow dene mein madad karta hai.[innovist.com](https://innovist.com/products/10-vitamin-c-serum-for-glowing-bright-skin-10-ml-pack-of-3#:~:text=*%20%E2%9C%93%20Made%20with%20pure%2C%20stable%20Ethyl,*%20%E2%9C%93%20Reduces%20melanin%20production%20by%202.5X.)

Yahan kuch top-rated aur popular options diye gaye hain jinhe aap try kar sakte hain:

Yeh Minimalist 10% Vitamin C Face Serum **beginner-friendly** hai, jo dull skin aur halka dark spots ko theek karne ke liye **lightweight aur gentle** formula deta hai.

Yeh Plum 15% Vitamin C Face Serum With Mandarin **stubborn dark spots** ke liye behtar hai aur **mandarin & kakadu plum** ke sath instant glow deta hai.

Yeh Dot & Key 10% Vitamin C + E 5% Niacinamide Serum **Niacinamide** ke sath aata hai jo spots kam karne ke sath-sath **skin texture** ko bhi behtar banata hai.

Yeh Chemist At Play 10% Vitamin C Face Serum **Glucosamine** ke sath enriched hai jo melanin balance karke **uneven skin tone aur dullness** ko dur karta hai.

* Agar aapki skin sensitive hai, toh 10% concentration se shuru karna sabse behtar rahega.
